blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) is assisting 94 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) and the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) whose Riyadh-bound flights were diverted to Jeddah following an attack at Saudi Arabia’s King Khalid International Airport, as authorities continue to deal with flight cancellations and travel disruptions. Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said on Monday that the affected passengers were staying in Jeddah while waiting for flights to Riyadh to resume. The DMW is helping them rebook their tickets and providing food, transportation, and temporary accommodation. READ: 4 Filipinos injured in Riyadh airport attack; 3 admitted in ICU […]...
